baseline.note: The lifecycle matrix document was removed from the tree by the documentation consolidation; its last content is git show f7c06383:docs/architecture/service-lifecycle-tests.md. This file is now the machine-readable record, and tools.boundary_inventory verifies every cited test is still registered.

owners.ci-orchestration: CI orchestration: selection, workflow callers, shared guards, evidence tooling.
owners.test-support-runtime-lifecycle: Test support and runtime lifecycle: fixtures, ownership, readiness and teardown.
owners.platform-reproduction: Platform reproduction: account/NSS identity, container and hosted-OS parity.
owners.producer-consumer: The team that changes either side of the boundary owns updating its tests, this entry and the owning gate.

shared-guards.title: Shared pre-push guards
shared-guards.certifies: Cross-language metadata, lint/type, workflow and inventory guards. Does not certify native, Dart, compiled-service or installed behavior.

python-coverage.title: Python suite with the 95% coverage gate
python-coverage.certifies: The offline Python tooling suite under the unchanged combined coverage floor.

platform-contracts.title: Host platform Python contracts
platform-contracts.certifies: Real compiler, filesystem and shell behavior of the shared host contracts on this host's operating system only.

bindings-check.title: Generated protobuf bindings drift
bindings-check.certifies: Generated Dart bindings match the proto sources with the pinned compiler. Proves schema sync only, not consumer behavior.

native-stage.title: Native configure, compile and CTest (build.sh native stage)

reuse.decision: An existing build tree is reconfigured and incrementally rebuilt by the entrypoint; unchanged objects are reused, not freshly compiled.

native-stage.certifies: Native targets compile and their CTest suite passes on this host.

core-stage.title: Core Dart analyze and tests against the native library (build.sh core stage)

reuse.decision: The core gate consumes the existing native library through the entrypoint's runtime-support verification; this check does not rebuild it.

core-stage.certifies: Source/JIT Dart core tests (including core-native cases whose skips are inventoried) against the named native library.

desktop-stage.title: Desktop Flutter analyze and tests (build.sh desktop stage)

reuse.decision: The desktop gate consumes the existing native library; this check does not rebuild it.

desktop-stage.certifies: Source/JIT Flutter widget and desktop tests. Native-UI integration tests run only with a configured display.

service-stage.title: Compiled service, MCP and helper integration (build.sh service stage)

reuse.decision: build_service_gate.sh runs the compiled boundary without rebuilding it; the service, MCP and helper bytes are reused and verified only by the entrypoint's runtime-support and diagnostic-worker checks.

service-stage.certifies: The compiled desktop-service/MCP/helper boundary with production executables. Native-display tests inside it fail rather than skip when no display is configured.

document-sandbox.title: Linux document import sandbox
document-sandbox.certifies: PDF and RTF fixtures through the production Dart parser under the real sandbox. Meant for a disposable Ubuntu host; it may apply AppArmor policy only on GitHub-hosted runners.

integration-fast.title: Fast Dart integration group (integration_gates --suite fast)

reuse.decision: Consumes the existing native library; not rebuilt by this check.

integration-fast.certifies: The exact expected number of executed fast-group tests with no skips.

integration-models.title: Real-model acceptance group (integration_gates --suite models)

reuse.decision: The prepared application bundle and checksum-pinned model fixtures are consumed as built; this check does not rebuild or re-verify them.

integration-models.certifies: Real model, helper and Google-fixture groups from a prepared bundle. Linux runtime container only.

integration-virtual-audio.title: Virtual-audio acceptance group (integration_gates --suite virtual-audio)

reuse.decision: The prepared bundle and model fixtures are consumed as built.

integration-virtual-audio.certifies: Whisper partial/final, virtual microphone outage and the meeting workflow in a disposable container without /dev/snd.

dmg-contracts.title: Apple DMG signing, mount and upgrade contracts
dmg-contracts.certifies: Both real Apple signing/mount and upgrade contracts; a wholly skipped contract fails.

native-sanitizers.title: Native sanitizer gates
native-sanitizers.requirement: Requires the hosted instrumented ASan/UBSan/TSan SDKs and containers; no checked-in local entrypoint reproduces their SDK identity. Run through the sanitizer workflow, or tools/run_native_sanitizers.sh with an independently built instrumented tree.

hosted-acceptance.title: Hosted acceptance jobs (CPU, virtual audio, DEB)
hosted-acceptance.requirement: These required jobs consume the in-run qualified application producer's exact bytes inside runtime containers; acceptance-deb installs the DEB. No checked-in local entrypoint reproduces that producer-bound execution. integration-models and integration-virtual-audio run the same groups against a prepared bundle but do not certify the hosted jobs.

hosted-linux-native.title: Hosted Linux native job (Arch Core)
hosted-linux-native.requirement: The Arch Linux native and Core jobs run in the hosted pinned image with its account and NSS setup; they are reproduced only by the hosted workflow or an equivalent pinned container, not by a local entrypoint.

hosted-packaging.title: Hosted installer and package contracts
hosted-packaging.requirement: DEB/RPM/Arch installer matrix, upgrade and relocation checks execute only in the hosted package workflows against the current run's bundle; there is no whole-matrix local entrypoint.

installed-acceptance.title: Installed-product acceptance
installed-acceptance.requirement: Run the installed-release acceptance (tools/test_installed_release.py via the release-acceptance and preview workflows or packaging/ci/test-release-package.sh) and the installed GUI approval procedure against the exact qualified installer bytes. Record installer digest and source revision with the result.
installed-acceptance.certifies: Cannot be satisfied by any source-tree or build-tree check.

manual-probes.title: Manual diagnostic probes
manual-probes.requirement: Diagnostic probes in tools/integration_probes.json with mode manual need an installed runtime, models, an owned desktop session or physical hardware. Run only with their documented fixtures and authorization, and record the results; they are not release acceptance unless actually run.

lifecycle_reconciliation.missing: The real ForesightHelper's own reception of a malformed or partial frame is untested; the fixture peer shows only how the client side settles. Failures before the handshake completes, and a frame that never finishes, are not reported promptly: the call waits for its deadline (45 s by default, 30 minutes for indexDocument). A peer that closes after the handshake does fail promptly, but as UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE rather than a protocol-specific code.
lifecycle_reconciliation.note: Six hostile-peer scenarios: non-HTTP/2 bytes, close before any frame, handshake plus a huge announced payload, half a frame header then silence, half a frame header then EOF, handshake then EOF. Each settles as a GrpcError, nothing reaches the error zone, and the same channel serves a valid replacement.
